name: Frigo 2
description: The DynamicRoll® Frigo 2 is a high-performance freezer door engineered for extreme cold environments. It features a double curtain design that traps air between layers for superior thermal insulation. Its rapid open-and-close speeds, full perimeter seal, and self-reinserting curtain prevent frost buildup and dramatically reduce energy loss in high-traffic cold storage areas.

name: Frigo 2 Air
description: The DynamicRoll® Frigo 2 Air High Speed Door is a cutting-edge solution for cold storage and temperature-sensitive environments. It features a unique dual-curtain design with an intelligent air barrier that prevents ice buildup and minimizes thermal exchange. Combining an insulated with a full perimeter seal, it has the ability to maintain climate control in areas with extreme temperature differences.

name: Dynamicroll B-Drive
description: The DynamicRoll® B-Drive Fabric Roll-Up Door is a high-performance, all-purpose belt-driven door that offers versatility across a wide range of industries and environments. It offers multiple activation options and excels in adaptability.

name: Dynamicroll CB125
description: The DynamicRoll® CB 125 high-speed, fabric roll-up door specifically designed for cleanroom environments, providing airtight sealing, fast operation, and contamination control to maintain strict hygiene and temperature stability.

name: Dynamicroll CB230
description: The DynamicRoll® CB 230 is a high-speed cleanroom door designed for interlock systems and includes a built-in escape function for enhanced safety. Compared to the CB 125, it features a soft bottom edge for flexible floor sealing and is ideal for multi-door cleanroom environments requiring pressure control and quick access.

name: Dynamicroll Food PE
description: The DynamicRoll® Food PE is a high-speed door engineered for food processing environments with a chemical-resistant polyethylene frame. Its full-perimeter seal minimizes air exchange and help deter cross-contamination between zones. With FDA-approved, washable materials and a compact, low-maintenance build, it’s the ideal solution for clean, efficient, and compliant food facility operations.

name: Dynamicroll Food Stainless
description: The DynamicRoll® Food Stainless High Speed Door is built for environments that demand frequent wash downs. The slanted barrel hood and one-piece cover prevents build up of water, dust, and debris. It excels in harsh, humid, or salty conditions while maintaining a tight perimeter seal with a fast, self-reinserting operation. It’s the ideal choice when durability, hygiene, and long-term performance are essential in demanding applications.
